To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) newly-graduated nurses experience a variety of challenges during their first months of practice; 2) these challenges are related to their professional identity, role transition and the work environment; 3) newly graduated nurses experience both negative and positive emotions during the first months after graduation; 4) newly graduated nurses' experiences are influenced by the organizational culture, and 5) newly graduated nurses need support from their colleagues and supervisors during their first months after graduation.
